title: Research: price matrix-owner QQ16 cover routing on tagged tapes
body:
PR3270 counts 528 full-cover QQ16 B1 transfers while leaving physical routing unpriced. This isolated package gives a constructive four-tape routing theorem for the actual **matrix-owner** semidirect action, on an explicit tagged entry stream with three clean buffers. Stable radix partitions implement the permutation, restore the buffers, return the heads and preserve arbitrary dirty exterior. Independent supplied tape origins and extra spectator tapes are covered by the stated coordinate/embedding arguments.

For d = n² + nλ, S = |D| 2^(nλ), L = d + B + 2 and q = n nnz(g⁻¹) + nλ[1 + wt(g⁻¹δ)], the informal proof bounds literal cell actions by

    S [(2d + 2)q + (32d + 32)L] + 64(d + 1).

The frozen B1 certificate has 512 distinct maps and 528 uses, with occurrence-weighted coefficient reads Q = 5,451,056. The package gives the corresponding conditional cover-only polynomial. W means stored component bits, including sign/format; no numerical guard or completed-consumer width is silently substituted.

Validation: registered Python 3.12 replay and separate read-only Git-free `-O` replay pass all 28 controller cases and five behavioral/rejection controls (9,137,626 metered actions). Exact 73-axis source inverses and q are reconstructed with separate row/column arithmetic. A separate source-tamper control rejects before decompression. Lean 4.34.1 / pinned Mathlib builds and independently audits **only the algebraic inverse**, with `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. The physical controller/cost proof is informal. The final patch reproduces every file byte-for-byte at the pinned base.

Scope: changed `joint-query-controller` card, priority revision 6. Owner-set closure, tagged entry preparation, three clean work buffers and actual stored width are explicit premises. The program family is nonuniform in n, λ and map. No actual caller, favorable complete supplier invoice, all-size compiler or new κ is supplied; selected science and frozen predecessors are unchanged. Hosted CI and the selected full cold replay are unrun. Stop after this local contract.

Reuse and credit: MathProof's absolute unit-time model, finite dirty-frame principle, tape embedding and independent-origin relocation; Ali Romman's joint-query construction; Nick Petalas (PR3270/3303/3339 and retained numeric/decoder lineage); commdata2338, Sricharan Vagvala, Tekalign, Ross Richardson, Arham Tahir and all retained supplier/native/bridge contributors. Sagar Thakrar's PR3241/3377 are distinct paid-access/dispatch results. Concurrent PR3374 by Wentao Li supplies a complementary partial F17 arithmetic bill while leaving maps/movement unpaid. Exact heads and further attribution are in OVERLAP.md, PRECEDENTS.json and NOTICE.md. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review claimed. New work is Apache-2.0.

Scientific and final compatibility base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`; final main/overlap checkpoint 2026-10-18 00:04 UTC, with 296 open PR bodies fully paginated and 200 recent closed bodies partially paginated. Discussion history is incomplete; no exhaustive novelty claim.

Merge danger: two-way, research only, one new isolated package. No selected-frontier or shared-tool changes.
